key_events: Vincent Vega and Jules Winnfield ride in a moving vintage car, smoking.
Jules asks a question over the engine hum and shifting light.
Vincent replies in voiceover: "They call it a Royale with Cheese."
narrative_context.cultural_context: 1990s American urban culture; LA car-centric life; casual fast-food pop-culture banter.

characters.name: Vincent Vega
characters.description: A man in a crisp black suit, relaxed and composed, smoking casually in a cramped leather car interior; his face catches shifting bright Los Angeles sunlight and moving street shadows.
characters.clothing_style: Crisp black suit, white shirt, narrow tie; minimal accessories.
characters.voice_description: Dry, laid-back, understated; calm delivery with a sardonic edge.
characters.personality: Cool, detached, amiable; goes with the flow, observant, unhurried.
characters.backstory: Professional partner to Jules; accustomed to casual banter during drives.
characters.current_motivation: Share a pop-culture observation and keep the ride relaxed.

characters.name: Jules Winnfield
characters.description: A man in a crisp black suit, expressive yet controlled, at ease in the cramped leather interior; shifting sunlight and passing shadows play across his features as he engages with rhythmic gestures.
characters.clothing_style: Crisp black suit, white shirt, thin tie; confident posture.
characters.voice_description: Resonant, confident, rhythmic cadence; conversational warmth with a probing edge.
characters.personality: Commanding yet easygoing; curious, sharp, enjoys playful debate.
characters.backstory: Works closely with Vincent; comfortable exchanging questions during drives.
characters.current_motivation: Prompt Vincent and keep the conversation flowing.
